job.question: In the Q&A for an external audit RFP for a retirement system whose general ledger system is Microsoft Dynamics SL, what were the total contractual fees for the prior year (FY2021) audits?
job.expected_facts: $73,000 (Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System, RFP 515-22-300 Q&A).
job.acceptance: $73,000 for FY2021 audits suffices; issuer/RFP number optional.

reviews.reason: This is an October 2022 custody-services RFP Q&A from Orange County Employees Retirement System, not the external-audit RFP Q&A described in the question. Its fee disclosure concerns custodial services, not total contractual fees for FY2021 audits.
quotes: Custody Services Request for Proposal Questions & Answers October 2022 Orange County Employees Retirement System (OCERS)
Question 27: What are your current custodial fees? Are the fees for the scope of work as described in this RFP?
Answer: We have a flat fee of $580,000 for custody, accounting, cash management, performance reporting, and risk report services.
